exposure: Conventional ICSI group subdivided into ICSI-1 (semen suitable for in vitro fertilization, IVF) and ICSI-2 (poor semen quality)
outcome: Neonatal outcomes including sex ratio, birth weight, neonatal intensive care unit admission and birth defects
cohort: Women with primary infertility who underwent their first assisted reproductive technology cycles at a center in 2012-2017 (n=760)
finding: For women with primary infertility at high risk of IVF fertilization failure, rescue ICSI provides a safe and efficient alternative to minimize FF after initial IVF, but results in fewer TQE on day 3.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was measured as an outcome
